City population

metrics.measurement: event- or configuration-specific; not a permanent universal maximum

Annual square visitation
scope: 未取得广场级完整年度统计；不以威尼斯全市游客量或教堂入场人数替代。
No complete square-level annual series found; city tourism and basilica admissions are excluded.

label: 600米图幅建筑覆盖率
Buildings in the 600 m frame
scope: 统一600 × 600米图幅；合并并裁切真实建筑轮廓后计算。分母含水面；不是公共开放率。
Union of source footprints clipped to the same 600 × 600 m frame. Denominator includes water; not a public-open-space ratio.
metrics.measurement: computed footprint union / 360000 m²; source dates differ

label: 空间形态
Spatial form
text: Piazza、柱廊与Piazzetta形成由围合到水岸的清晰序列。
Piazza, arcades and Piazzetta form a legible sequence from enclosure to waterfront.

label: 交通可达性
Public transport
text: 以水上巴士加步行为主；不是汽车直达型广场。
Waterbus plus walking is the principal approach, not direct car access.

label: 景观融入
Landscape integration
text: 以潟湖水岸及硬质铺地为主，广场核心并非植被公园。
Lagoon frontage and paving dominate; the square core is not a planted park.

label: 商业界面
Commercial edges
text: 咖啡座与商铺沿建筑边缘展开；商业座位不能等同免费公共座位。
Cafes and shops line the edges; commercial seats are not free public seating.

label: 气候适应
Climate response
text: 夏季日晒与湿热、降雨及异常高潮位影响使用；覆盖边缘和预警是主要应对。
Summer sun and humidity, rain and high tides affect use; covered edges and warnings provide responses.

label: 使用功能
Use programme
text: 穿行／停留／文化参观／公共活动四类功能并存。
Passage / staying / cultural visits / public events coexist.

label: 平日／节假日
Ordinary / holiday use
text: 平日以游览、步行和外摆为主；狂欢节等活动可限制入口和容量。
Ordinary days emphasise visits, walking and terraces; Carnival events can impose entry and capacity limits.

label: 容量与年到访量
Capacity & annual visitation
text: 2018活动上限20,000人；广场级年到访量未确认。
2018 event cap: 20,000; square-level annual visitation remains unestablished.

label: 科技接入
Technology
text: 活动限流使用数字计数设备；潮汐监测与预警服务通行，非娱乐屏幕主导。
Digital event counting and tide warnings support management; entertainment screens are not the defining infrastructure.

label: 服务对象
Community / tourism
text: 服务社区仪式与公共生活，同时是全球游客目的地；不赋虚构居民／游客比例。
Serves civic rituals and public life as well as global visitors; no resident/tourist percentage is invented.

title: 连续柱廊
Continuous arcades
text: 把建筑立面转化为有遮蔽、可穿行的公共边缘。
Turns building fronts into covered, walkable public edges.

title: 广场—水岸序列
Square–waterfront sequence
text: 从围合的Piazza经过Piazzetta到潟湖，空间有方向也有变化。
Moves from enclosed Piazza through Piazzetta to lagoon with both direction and variety.

title: 仪式与日常共用
Ritual and everyday sharing
text: 同一公共地面容纳日常穿行、文化参观及城市仪式。
One civic ground supports daily passage, cultural visits and civic ritual.

title: Piazza San Marco
Piazza San Marco
lede: 以连续柱廊围合城市舞台，再通过Piazzetta把空间打开到潟湖。
A civic stage enclosed by arcades, opening through the Piazzetta to the lagoon.

label: 面积：Piazza主体12,600 m²（二级资料）
Area: Piazza proper 12,600 m² (secondary source)

title: 位置：步行街巷与水上交通之间
Location: between pedestrian lanes and water transport
lede: 市镇常住人口251,294人（2025年末）；数字包含大陆地区，广场位于历史岛城。
251,294 municipal residents at end-2025, including the mainland; the square lies in the historic island city.

title: 公共交通
Public transport
text: 可乘ACTV水上巴士到San Marco–Vallaresso或San Zaccaria，再步行进入广场。
ACTV waterbuses serve San Marco–Vallaresso and San Zaccaria, followed by a walk into the square.

title: 最后一段步行
The final walk
text: Piazza与水岸由步行地面连接；桥梁、潮位及临时通道会改变实际到达条件。
Pedestrian ground joins Piazza and waterfront; bridges, tides and temporary routes affect access.

title: 城市角色
Civic role
text: 既是世界级旅游焦点，也承载城市仪式与公共活动；不能把全部使用都解释成游客消费。
A major tourism focus that also hosts civic rituals and public events; use is not reducible to tourist consumption.

label: 威尼斯市政府：2025居民人口
City of Venice: 2025 residents
威尼斯市政府：Marciana无障碍到达指引
City of Venice: Marciana access routes

title: 历史：逐步封合的公共舞台
History: an incrementally enclosed civic stage
lede: 广场的整体性来自长期累积的建筑边界，而不是一次建设完成。
Its coherence comes from successive architectural edges rather than a single construction phase.

title: 扩展
Expansion
text: 广场在中世纪逐步扩展，形成大教堂前的主要公共地面。
Medieval expansion established the principal public ground before the basilica.

title: 围合
Enclosure
text: Procuratie的连续界面把多栋建筑联结成整体的城市房间。
The Procuratie’s continuous fronts unite separate buildings into a civic room.

title: 西端改造
Western transformation
text: 19世纪初的拿破仑翼改变西端边界，使广场的空间围合更完整。
The early-19th-century Napoleonic Wing changed the western edge and completed the enclosure.

title: 同一比例，看三种城市肌理
One scale, three urban fabrics
lede: 在同一图幅中，Piazza表现为密集城市肌理里的大块开放地面，并向水岸展开。
Within the common frame, Piazza appears as a substantial opening in dense urban fabric, extending to water.

text: 三案均为600 × 600米，北向上、横纵同尺度；矢量图按300毫米宽输出时为1:2500。网页缩放请读图形比例尺。
All three frames cover 600 × 600 m, north up with identical axis scale. Native SVG at 300 mm width is 1:2500; use the graphic bar on screens.

title: 平面：空间如何组织
Plan: how the place is organised
lede: Piazza与Piazzetta形成不同朝向、相互连续的公共地面。
Piazza and Piazzetta form connected civic surfaces with different orientations.

text: Piazza的长向空间指向大教堂；Piazzetta转向水岸。连续地面把围合与开敞两种体验串成一次步行。
The Piazza leads toward the basilica, while the Piazzetta turns to the waterfront. Continuous ground links enclosure and openness in one walk.

title: 剖面：地面、柱廊与地标
Section: ground, arcade and landmark
lede: 历史建筑图帮助理解垂直边界；地面本身不以明显坡地组织方向。
Historic drawings explain vertical edges; strong ground slopes are not the organising device.

text: 在这里，空间的主要变化来自建筑边界与垂直地标。历史剖面保留建筑层级；它不是整个广场的最新地形测绘。
Here, architectural edges and vertical landmarks drive the spatial change. The historic section retains building levels; it is not a current terrain survey of the whole square.

title: 连接：抵达、穿行与停留
Connections: arrival, passage and staying
lede: 圣马可既是目的地，也是从城市街巷到水岸的通道。
San Marco is both destination and passage between city lanes and waterfront.

title: 抵达
Arrival
text: 水上交通把到达点放在广场边缘，再转为步行。
Water transport places arrival near the edge, followed by walking.

title: 穿行
Passage
text: Piazzetta把城市广场与潟湖门厅联结起来。
Piazzetta links the civic square and lagoon threshold.

title: 停留
Staying
text: 中央与柱廊边缘提供不同的开敞和遮蔽体验。
Centre and arcade edges provide different degrees of openness and cover.
此处是形态与路线解读，不是已计算的整合度或VGA热图。
This is a reading of form and routes, not a computed integration or VGA map.

label: 官方到达与无障碍路线
Official access and step-free route information

title: 边界：建筑与公共地面
Edges: buildings meet civic ground
lede: 柱廊提供连续边缘，大教堂与钟楼提供强烈的定位参照。
Arcades provide a continuous edge; basilica and bell tower provide clear orientation.

text: 柱廊、首层开口和咖啡外摆共同使建筑边界成为可使用的空间；中央铺地则保留为穿行、停留与活动的共同场地。
Arcades, ground-floor openings and cafe terraces make the edge usable; the centre remains shared ground for passage, staying and events.

title: 环境：景观、气候与科技
Environment: landscape, climate and technology
lede: 硬质地面、潟湖背景与覆盖柱廊共同塑造使用条件；天气适应的关键是遮蔽与潮位管理。
Paving, lagoon setting and covered arcades shape use; cover and tide management are the principal environmental responses.

title: 景观
Landscape
text: 潟湖是最重要的自然背景，广场内部以石材铺地为主。
The lagoon is the principal natural setting; stone paving dominates within the square.

title: 天气与气候
Weather and climate
text: 气候偏湿润，夏季热、冬季凉；市中心2001—2020降雨研究中9月、11月较湿。柱廊提供局部遮蔽，高潮位需独立预警。
Humid conditions with warm summers and cool winters; central-city 2001–2020 records show wetter September and November. Arcades offer local cover; high tides require separate warnings.

title: 科技
Technology
text: 潮汐预报和活动数字计数服务空间管理。
Tide forecasting and digital event counting support spatial management.

label: 威尼斯市：2001—2020市中心降雨研究
City of Venice: central-city rainfall, 2001–2020

title: 平日：人们怎样使用这里
Ordinary days: how people use the place
lede: 同一地面支持穿行、文化参观、自由停留和咖啡消费；免费与商业空间应分开阅读。
The same ground supports passage, cultural visits, informal stay and cafe consumption; free and commercial spaces are distinct.

text: 平日的公共性来自自由穿行与停留，也受到商业外摆和游览组织的影响。
Ordinary-day publicness includes free movement and staying, shaped also by terraces and visitor management.

label: 市政府：商业外摆占地管理
Municipality: outdoor terrace occupation

title: 节假日与活动：地面的另一种状态
Holidays and events: the ground transforms
lede: 活动日改变进入方式与使用密度；潮汐积水则改变可走的路线。
Events change entry arrangements and crowding; tidal flooding changes usable routes.

title: 数字：规模、容量与使用强度
Numbers: scale, capacity and use
lede: 人口按市镇／LGA范围；容量是特定活动或场地布置口径；年到访量单独列出。
Population uses municipal/LGA boundaries; capacity is event- or layout-specific; annual visitation is listed separately.

text: 活动容量不是全年访客量，也不是随时允许进入的人数。三案未公开同口径的平日／节假日人流序列，因此不伪造倍数关系。
Event capacity is neither annual visitation nor a constant admission allowance. Matched ordinary-day/holiday footfall series are unavailable, so no multiplier is invented.

title: 统一评价①：空间与环境
Aligned assessment 1: space and environment
lede: 以下五项在三个案例中采用完全相同的名称、顺序和判断口径。
The same five dimensions, in the same order and with the same interpretation, apply to all three cases.

title: 统一评价②：使用与公共性
Aligned assessment 2: use and publicness
lede: 区分功能、时段、规模、科技与服务对象；BOTH表示社区与游客均被服务，不代表两者人数相等。
Separate programme, timing, scale, technology and users. BOTH means both communities and visitors are served, not equal headcounts.

title: 最突出的三个特点
Three defining qualities
lede: 它最值得借鉴的是边界与空间序列，而不是孤立地复制纪念性建筑。
Its transferable strength lies in edges and spatial sequence rather than isolated monumental objects.

text: 同一公共地面容纳日常穿行、文化参观及城市仪式。
One civic ground supports daily passage, cultural visits and civic ritual.
主要限制：旅游压力、商业占地和潮汐会改变公共空间的实际可用范围。

intro_lede: 以连续柱廊围合城市舞台，再通过Piazzetta把空间打开到潟湖。
A civic stage enclosed by arcades, opening through the Piazzetta to the lagoon.
plan_text: Piazza的长向空间指向大教堂；Piazzetta转向水岸。连续地面把围合与开敞两种体验串成一次步行。
The Piazza leads toward the basilica, while the Piazzetta turns to the waterfront. Continuous ground links enclosure and openness in one walk.

text: 在这里，空间的主要变化来自建筑边界与垂直地标。历史剖面保留建筑层级；它不是整个广场的最新地形测绘。
Here, architectural edges and vertical landmarks drive the spatial change. The historic section retains building levels; it is not a current terrain survey of the whole square.

syntax_lede: 圣马可既是目的地，也是从城市街巷到水岸的通道。
San Marco is both destination and passage between city lanes and waterfront.

label: 官方到达与无障碍路线
Official access and step-free route information

boundary_lede: 柱廊提供连续边缘，大教堂与钟楼提供强烈的定位参照。
Arcades provide a continuous edge; basilica and bell tower provide clear orientation.
boundary_text: 柱廊、首层开口和咖啡外摆共同使建筑边界成为可使用的空间；中央铺地则保留为穿行、停留与活动的共同场地。
Arcades, ground-floor openings and cafe terraces make the edge usable; the centre remains shared ground for passage, staying and events.
environment_lede: 硬质地面、潟湖背景与覆盖柱廊共同塑造使用条件；天气适应的关键是遮蔽与潮位管理。
Paving, lagoon setting and covered arcades shape use; cover and tide management are the principal environmental responses.

label: 威尼斯市：2001—2020市中心降雨研究
City of Venice: central-city rainfall, 2001–2020

life_lede: 同一地面支持穿行、文化参观、自由停留和咖啡消费；免费与商业空间应分开阅读。
The same ground supports passage, cultural visits, informal stay and cafe consumption; free and commercial spaces are distinct.

label: 市政府：商业外摆占地管理
Municipality: outdoor terrace occupation

event_lede: 活动日改变进入方式与使用密度；潮汐积水则改变可走的路线。
Events change entry arrangements and crowding; tidal flooding changes usable routes.
conclusion_lede: 它最值得借鉴的是边界与空间序列，而不是孤立地复制纪念性建筑。
Its transferable strength lies in edges and spatial sequence rather than isolated monumental objects.
conclusion_limit: 主要限制：旅游压力、商业占地和潮汐会改变公共空间的实际可用范围。
Principal limitation: tourism pressure, commercial occupation and tides affect usable public space.
